question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
-- Step 2: Calculate average of total runs scored by qualifying strikers
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) > 50
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker FROM striker_match_runs
),
striker_totals AS (
    SELECT b.striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker
)
SELECT AVG(st.total_runs) AS avg_total_runs
FROM striker_totals st
INNER JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON st.striker = qs.striker
